name: aiPHeed governing model configuration: 45-candidate feature set (MODEL-B2)
decided: 2026-10-09, researcher decision: the 45-feature configuration governs the thesis model
status: Governing configuration for thesis evaluation. NOT served: production still serves MODEL-A (12 features, models/lgbm_best.pkl) until replacement is separately authorized.

additional_inputs.cpi_dev: Equation 5's CPI_dev: province food CPI YoY minus the province's mean of its prior 4 quarters (feature_matrix.py, CPI_DEV_WINDOW = 4)
additional_inputs.sws_hunger: SWS hunger prevalence (Section 3.3.2.6 source) as the latest round released before the forecast quarter t+1 begins; never the label quarter's value

feature_set.selection: none: the Section 3.3.2.7 correlation/SHAP reduction is not applied

algorithm: Algorithm 3: LightGBM LGBMClassifier, library defaults except scale_pos_weight

class_weighting.rule: (1 - p) / p, p = HIGH share of the fold's training rows
class_weighting.note: Departs from Algorithm 3's 'default LightGBM classifier'; requires adviser approval (see docs/CHAPTER_III_RECONCILIATION_2026-10-09.md, item R6)

target: label_stress (Eq. 3; HIGH if stress_score > global median 14.6)
horizon: k = 1: features of quarter t -> label of t+1
timing: strict Rule 3 (frame_t2): government series of t-1; news of t; SWS latest round released before t+1; poverty incidence as published

walk_forward.train_rule: all rows whose target quarter precedes the test quarter

e29_leakage_flag.what: target uses a whole-period median (14.6) computed over all labelled quarters, including test quarters; expected_results were obtained under it and are not evidence
e29_leakage_flag.valid_rule: origin-specific threshold: median of labels published before the origin (E25-E29)
e29_leakage_flag.guard: app/ml/features/label_guard.py refuses the leaky label path unless AIPHEED_ALLOW_LEGACY_LEAKY_LABELS=1
